assumptions: T2 (Binance proxy) scope = 12/39 coins (95% cum-notional rule was larger); remaining 27 coin(s) use T1 (if recent) or T3 only. Computed from the wallet's full raw history (not the E_min-pushed scored window) since it feeds price prefetch.

L_t (leader daily equity for proportional sizing, v0.4 §1.2) = linear interpolation of portfolio.allTime.accountValueHistory to each day's 00:00 UTC boundary — the leader's REAL reported equity, NOT netted against deposits/withdrawals (v0.3's netting was reverted; the leader sizes positions against what they actually have). Falls back to the leader's own fills-based MTM curve on 0/612 day(s) of the full raw history outside accountValueHistory's covered range.

D1-c loss(e) = qty*(p_recon - p_exec) + (catch-up slippage + catch-up fee), qty signed (v0.4 sign fix vs v0.3, which had the first term negated). loss(e) can be negative (a missed trade followed by a favorable price move before catch-up is a net benefit). Does not add back the fee/slippage the original (now-skipped) t+δ trade would have paid — the formula as given only adds the catch-up leg's own friction, so loss(e) is the INCREMENTAL cost of deferring this one trade, not a full swap-accounting of both legs.
D2/gate denominators (peak/day-equity C_t) floored at 1% of E0 on at least one day to avoid divide-by-zero
data_limits: 延遲成本用 Binance 1m 代理／HL 1m 的相對變動估算（保真 0.7–0.9 → 偏樂觀）；δ 小於 1 分鐘時延遲成本幾乎只剩滑價。
跟單者資金費 = 領單者 funding 列（只有前 500 筆）= 下界。
延遲分布是假設值（未有實測）；漏單恢復是模型內的逐事件精算，不是實盤跟單記錄；前瞻分項是同窗口切分。
